nodes.label: upsert_chunks()
nodes.rationale: GameMemory.upsert_chunks returns count, stamps sid/turn/index, prefixes ids.

nodes.label: test_query_ranks_by_relevance_scoped_to_sid()
nodes.rationale: Goblin-king query ranks correct doc first and scopes all hits to requesting sid.

nodes.label: export()
nodes.rationale: export dumps content+metadata per sid, ignores other games, empty for unknown sid.

nodes.label: restore()/clear()
nodes.rationale: export->clear->restore roundtrip preserves ids; clear deletes only that sid; empty restore is noop.

nodes.label: upsert validation
nodes.rationale: Accepts plain-text docs with sid stamping; skips invalid docs; empty upsert/query are noops.
